title: Exposure to outdoor air pollution in urban areas
subtitle: Annual population-weighted average concentration of [fine particulate matter](#dod:particulate_matter_pollution) (PM2.5) in the air in urban areas. PM2.5 concentration is measured in micrograms per cubic meter (µg/m³). Exposure to fine particulate matter can pose significant health risks.
